mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a deepening labor market crisis, which increases the risk of corporate earnings deterioration and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an active monetary policy response to a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes a market rebound as investors anticipate economic stabilization and corporate earnings recovery over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor market deterioration
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise) fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST rising above 1300 thousand units), the improvement in residential construction activity signals strengthening consumer spending and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in the real economy, which increases the risk of corporate earnings declines and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth rate below -1.0% signals a technical recession, which increases the probability of corporate earnings contraction and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth < -1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates deflationary pressures, which heighten the risk of a prolonged economic contraction and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in retail sales (RSAFS) and decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals robust consumer spending without inflationary pressures, which typically precedes a market rally as investors anticipate sustainable corporate earnings growth over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS rise and CPIAUCSL decline) fails to produce positive 60d returns in > 50% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p>0.05.
